issues.claim: Restaurant industry net margin between 1% and 7%, "which is the paper's own stated reason technology investment is hard to justify in this sector"
issues.problem: The 1%-7% figure is verbatim in the paper, but the paper does not argue that low margins make technology investment hard to justify; it argues the opposite - that a 2.91% sales lift is practically significant 'given the low-margin nature of the casual dining business'. The framing inverts the source's point.
issues.fix: Rephrase: the paper cites 1%-7% margins as the reason a ~3% sales lift is economically meaningful, not as a reason investment is hard to justify.
